name: Arbiter-9 v3 clean (ranks stored + submission control)

notes.text: GAME OF THE GENERALS - BATTLE ARBITER
ENCODING: Flag=0000, Private=0001, Sergeant=0010, 2LT=0011, 1LT=0100, CPT=0101, MAJ=0110, LTC=0111, COL=1000, Brig=1001, MajGen=1010, LtGen=1011, 4-Star=1100, 5-Star=1101, Spy=1110. 1111 is unused.
TURN: set exactly one of Turn_A / Turn_B HIGH only when both pieces are Flags. The attacker wins Flag-vs-Flag; both LOW is undefined/no-winner.
INPUTS: 10k pull-downs. OUTPUT LEDs: 330R series resistors. POWER: regulated 5V; 74HC logic below 5.5V.
9-LED OUTPUT STRIP: A_Win / Tie / B_Win / Flag_A / Flag_B / A_Final / B_Final / Turn_A / Turn_B.

REAL BUILD: 74HC-series logic at regulated 5.0 V (absolute max 5.5 V). Wire each DIP-switch common to +5 V; every signal has its own 10k pull-down. 330R in series with every LED (~9 mA). Fit 100nF from +5 V to GND at each IC. Tie every unused 74HC input to GND or +5 V; never leave it floating. The app's 7408/7432/7404/7485/7430 symbols represent 74HC08/74HC32/74HC04/74HC85/74HC30 packages.
WIRING: every component leg is in a breadboard hole. Routed wires avoid component pins and bodies; crossings pass over empty holes only. Keep the +5 V and GND rails continuous across boards.
UPGRADED ARBITER - RANK STORAGE + SUBMISSION CONTROL
GAME_OVER = latched(A_Win_Final OR B_Win_Final), cleared only by the RESET button. While HIGH it blocks both Accept terms. RESET also clears A_Done / B_Done for the next round.
PLAYER A edge -> SHARED: A_Done, /Reset, /Game_Over.  A rank bus A3..A0 stays on this board.
PLAYER B edge -> SHARED: B_Done, /Reset, /Game_Over.  B rank bus B3..B0 stays on this board.
SHARED edge -> PLAYER A/B: Display_Enable, /Reset, /Game_Over.  -> arbiter: A_Win/Tie/B_Win, A_Final/B_Final taps.
A/B rank DIP switches were MOVED onto the player boards (approved). The original arbiter boards, 9 LEDs and Turn switches are unchanged.
